page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-highmem-8 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor using the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. It is configured with 64 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance scoring in the top 25 percent. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth tests fall within the average range, with uncached read and write speeds at 57.86 GB/sec and 40.87 GB/sec respectively. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and medium-model LLM prompt processing represent relative performance bottlenecks, scoring in the bottom 25 percent.

Given its high memory density relative to compute resources, the n2d-highmem-8 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel processing or local NVMe storage. It is suitable for database caching, enterprise applications, in-memory data processing, and web serving workloads that benefit from a larger memory footprint without the cost of additional vCPUs.
